distinction: Issues below are data-quality or coverage findings. They are not measurements of public-transport accessibility.

dataset.name: Antalya public transport GTFS (KentKart-derived)
dataset.organization: Schedule data via KentKart; GTFS conversion by Egezenn/kk-gtfs
dataset.license: Unclear for redistribution. Converter code is MIT. A CC0 text is shipped with the generated files, and the converter README says the underlying data remain with KentKart and/or the municipal operator.
dataset.geographic_coverage: Feed stop bbox longitude 29.32007 to 32.31751, latitude 36.20068 to 37.23487. Phase 1 study area covers 237.0 km² and 2794 of 4630 valid stops.
dataset.temporal_coverage: calendar.txt stamps services from 20260901 to 20261031. This window is produced by the converter unless an official feed replaces it.
dataset.processing_notes: Downloaded from the published kk-gtfs zip and extracted without editing GTFS files. The study-area polygon and route register are separate project decisions.
limitations: Derived from the public KentKart API by the community converter Egezenn/kk-gtfs. This is not an official Antalya Büyükşehir GTFS publication.
The converter stamps calendar.txt from the generation date to 60 days later. That window is not evidence of the operator's validity period.

Intermediate stop times are the API's arrival and departure offsets added to each trip's first departure. They are scheduled inputs, not observed running times. A spot-check of 20 municipal timetable patterns is stored in reports/timetable_spot_check.html.
The feed's stop bbox extends beyond central Antalya, including provincial places such as Kaş and Gazipaşa. Those places are not the Phase 1 study area.
Services absent from this feed, including dolmuş, are not represented.
Wheelchair_boarding and wheelchair_accessible fields are absent.
The converter's README says underlying schedule copyright remains with KentKart and/or the municipality, while also attaching a CC0 text to the generated files. The zip is not committed to git.

parameters.hole_filling: Interior rings of the density union are removed before the buffer.
parameters.component: Connected component, among cells at or above the threshold, that contains the densest cell.
parameters.tie_break: Highest stop count, then lexicographic H3 index.
parameters.why_this_resolution: Resolution 8 is used only to delineate the dense service area. A finer cell often contains too few stops for a density threshold. This is not the Phase 2 accessibility lattice.

control_points.name: Kaleiçi
control_points.note: Historic centre of Antalya. A dense-service study area that misses this point is not the central urban network.

control_points.name: Kaş
control_points.note: Provincial town on the GTFS fringe. It must not enter the central comparison area.

control_points.name: Gazipaşa
control_points.note: Eastern provincial fringe of this feed. It must not enter the central comparison area.

control_points.name: Antalya Airport
control_points.note: Reported only. Failure does not by itself reject the polygon.

control_points.name: Kepez
control_points.note: Reported only. Approximate district centre, not an official centroid.

control_points.name: Döşemealtı
control_points.note: Reported only. The district is large; this point may sit outside the dense stop cluster.

route_decisions.rule: A route is included when at least 80 percent of its valid stops lie inside the study area and it has at least two valid stops. Quality flags do not by themselves exclude a route.

issues.message: Departure time is earlier than arrival time. 1347 of these differ by 60 seconds or less. Phase 1 records them and does not rewrite the feed.

Every service shares the window 20260901 to 20261031 (60 days). The KentKart converter writes the generation date and a date 60 days later. Treat this as a feed stamp, not as the operator's published validity period, until it is compared with an official timetable.
calendar_dates.txt is not in this feed. Public holidays inside the stamped window are not encoded.
transfers.txt is not in this feed. Phase 1 does not infer transfer rules.
This feed has no wheelchair_boarding or wheelchair_accessible fields. Step-free access cannot be assessed.
